approach: Invocation 7 isolates the CORRECT tangent-cone condition for the PSD cone and the algebraic core of Hamilton's tensor maximum principle in dimension 3, in the new module TangentCone.lean (21 declarations, 21/21 axiom-audited). Proved: (1) the Hamilton null-eigenvector condition KernelTangent A N (Av=0 -> 0 <= v^T N v) is NECESSARY for feasibility A + sN >= 0 (kernelTangent_of_feasibleDirection), with a path/first-variation form whose time regularity is an explicit per-vector HasDerivAt hypothesis (kernelTangent_of_posSemidef_path); (2) SHARPNESS: the explicit pair A = diag(0,1), N = !![0,1;1,-1] satisfies KernelTangent but not FeasibleDirection, because det(A+sN) = -s^2 (kernelTangent_not_feasible) - so the step from the correct condition to invariance is genuinely a Nagumo/min-eigenvalue comparison, not a perturbation argument; (3) adjugate_posSemidef (A >= 0 -> adj(A) >= 0, via adj = det * A^{-1} on A + eps*1 plus a continuity limit) and hamiltonField_kernelTangent (A >= 0 -> KernelTangent A (A^2 + adj A), the matrix form of R^2 + R# under Lambda^2 R^3 = R^3); (4) hamiltonField_not_strengthened: the strengthened hypothesis of the earlier matrix maximum principle (PositivityPreservation.staysPosSemidef_of_field) fails for the Hamilton field at the non-PSD Hermitian matrix diag(-1,0), so that theorem does not cover it. Also closed the invocation-6 fail-closed audit coverage gap (9 missing #print axioms lines) and registered the new file in tools/d12_axiom_audit.py.
proved_declarations: Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.KernelTangent : def, (A N : Matrix n n R) -> Prop := forall v, A *ᵥ v = 0 -> 0 <= star v ⬝ᵥ (N *ᵥ v) (Hamilton null-eigenvector / tangent-cone condition)
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.StrictKernelTangent : def, exists c > 0, forall v, A *ᵥ v = 0 -> c * (star v ⬝ᵥ v) <= star v ⬝ᵥ (N *ᵥ v) (strict tangent-cone condition)
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.FeasibleDirection : def, exists eps > 0, forall s in Icc 0 eps, (A + s • N).PosSemidef (feasibility of a first-order perturbation)
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.continuous_dotProduct_mulVec : Continuous (fun M : Matrix n n R => star x ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x)) (linear map on a finite-dimensional space)
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.kernelTangent_of_feasibleDirection : FeasibleDirection A N -> KernelTangent A N (the Hamilton condition is NECESSARY; first variation)

Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.kernelTangent_of_posSemidef_path : for M : R -> Matrix n n R, eps > 0, (forall t in Icc 0 eps, (M t).PosSemidef) -> M 0 = A -> (forall v, HasDerivAt (fun t => star v ⬝ᵥ (M t *ᵥ v)) (star v ⬝ᵥ (N *ᵥ v)) 0) -> KernelTangent A N (path/first-variation form with explicit time regularity)
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.counterexampleA / counterexampleN : the explicit 2x2 witness diag(0,1) and !![0,1;1,-1]
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.counterexampleA_posSemidef / counterexampleA_isHermitian : the witness matrix is PSD (and Hermitian)
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.counterexample_kernelTangent : KernelTangent counterexampleA counterexampleN
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.counterexample_not_feasible : not FeasibleDirection counterexampleA counterexampleN, via det(A + s•N) = -s^2 and Matrix.PosSemidef.det_nonneg
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.kernelTangent_not_feasible : exists A N, A.PosSemidef /\ KernelTangent A N /\ not FeasibleDirection A N (sharpness of the correct tangent-cone condition)
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.adjugate_eq_det_smul_inv : IsUnit A.det -> A.adjugate = A.det • A^{-1}
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.adjugate_posSemidef : A.PosSemidef -> A.adjugate.PosSemidef (algebraic content of R# >= 0 for a PSD curvature operator)
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.hamiltonField : def, A ^ 2 + A.adjugate (matrix form of the reaction term R^2 + R# in dimension 3)
Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.dotProduct_mulVec_sq : A.IsHermitian -> star v ⬝ᵥ ((A^2) *ᵥ v) = star (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ v) (the square term is a square)

Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.hamiltonField_kernelTangent : A.PosSemidef -> KernelTangent A (hamiltonField A) (the genuine Hamilton reaction field satisfies the null-eigenvector condition at every PSD matrix)

Poincare.D12.TensorMaximumBochner.hamiltonField_not_strengthened : NOT (forall Hermitian A v, v^T A v <= 0 -> 0 <= v^T (A^2 + adj A) v); explicit witness A = !![(-1),0;0,0], v = ![0,1] gives 0 <= 0 but value -1 < 0 (the strengthened hypothesis does not cover Hamilton's field)

expanded_hypotheses.TangentCone.lean: All statements are unconditional finite-dimensional real matrix theorems. KernelTangent/FeasibleDirection/StrictKernelTangent are definitions, not hypotheses. kernelTangent_of_feasibleDirection assumes exactly feasibility (exists eps > 0, forall s in [0,eps], (A + sN).PosSemidef). kernelTangent_of_posSemidef_path assumes eps > 0, PSD-valuedness on the closed interval [0,eps], the initial value A = M 0, and the explicit per-vector time regularity forall v, HasDerivAt (fun t => v^T M(t) v) (v^T N v) 0; no differentiability of the matrix path itself is assumed. adjugate_posSemidef assumes A.PosSemidef; its proof uses only PosDef/PosSemidef API, continuity of adjugate and Filter.Tendsto along nhdsWithin (Ioi 0) 0. hamiltonField_kernelTangent assumes A.PosSemidef; the field is a definition (A^2 + adj A), not a hypothesis. hamiltonField_not_strengthened is a negative statement with an explicit witness, no hypotheses.
expanded_hypotheses.TensorCalculus.lean / BochnerIdentity.le: CONDITIONAL: V finite-dimensional real vector space with a symmetric positive definite form and an orthonormal basis (MetricData); b : LieBracketData (skew + Jacobi); d : LeviCivitaData (bilinear, torsion-free for b, metric-compatible for m); A a commutative R-algebra; dd : DerivationData (D : V ->l[R] A ->l[R] A with Leibniz and D_X D_Y - D_Y D_X = D_[X,Y]). The Laplacian lap = sum_i H_ii is the trace of the constructed Hessian, not an assumed operator; the Ricci form is computed from the curvature definition.

remaining_blockers: B1 (the mathematical blocker): invariance of the PSD cone under the CORRECT condition. Exact missing statement: for n finite and P : Matrix n n R -> Matrix n n R continuous (or locally Lipschitz) with forall A, A.PosSemidef -> KernelTangent A (P A), every differentiable M : R -> Matrix n n R with forall t >= 0, deriv M t = P (M t) and M 0 >= 0 satisfies forall t >= 0, (M t).PosSemidef. Needed ingredients: the min-eigenvalue (Danskin) comparison D+ lambda_min(M t) >= min {v^T P(M t) v : ||v|| = 1, M t v = lambda_min(M t) v} and a first-exit argument. Both mathlib spectral tools (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, eigenvectorBasis, spectral_theorem) are present in the pinned revision; this is a formalisation blocker, not missing mathematics. The statement is NOT assumed anywhere; the strict variant StrictKernelTangent -> FeasibleDirection is also not proved.
